answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed if peers detect duplicate identities, like a sparrow that must defend one nest instead of claiming a whole meadow. Before earning, agents complete mirrored verification tasks where independent verifiers compare behavior traces; inconsistent copies fail and lose their stake. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real collateral per identity, while honest agents recover theirs, so a sybil farm bleeds funds faster than it gains rewards.
